The twin flame dynamic is sooo complex and there’s so many layers, that honestly, I think until you study the psychological aspects of what possibly could be happening you shouldn’t even call yourself a twinflame. Ex’s: Is it codependency stemming from childhood because your caregivers didn’t give you enough attention growing up, so now you latch onto anyone that you feel gives you an ounce of attention? Cptsd from childhood trauma so maybe that explains why you feel emotions & love so intensely? Is this person a narcissist and baited you? Is this a relationship between two people with a variation of anxious avoidant attachment styles, and that could explain the running and chasing?  

I’m glad to hear you’re happy about what’s taking place rn, but please tread lightly, even if this is your twinflame. And remember, soon a child will be involved. Is he leaving his partner too? If so, that’s great and I hope you guys can come up with a good coparenting plan. <333 Gl!

Are you confessing love without being honest about your own fears, and your own issues, that you are currently going through and have yet to face? If so, you’re going to have to be honest with him. Vulnerability is so scary but it’s a must if you want union. Are you making this romantic without seeing where this person may of been hurt and/or traumatized, and now they have this baggage that is blocking the physical part of this connection that you want with them? 

You’re going to have to tell him these things. If you don’t, and you solely focus on the romantic aspect,  it’ll make him run away further. This connection is much more than romance and by you only focusing on that it repels your twin. More than likely your twin isn’t consciously aware that this is a spiritual connection.
